name: Conán

attributes.attribute: cut himself out of the beast
stained red by the serpent's blood

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Conan is the hero of a tale told of a lake. A great serpent called Caoranach swallowed a hero at the water. The hero cut his way out and came out without skin or hair. He won the name bald Conan. The blood of the dying beast turned the lake red, and so it is called the Dark Lake. In a Christian form of the tale, Patrick himself is swallowed and cuts out with his curi.

okr.objective: Conan is the hero who survives the lake serpent and earns a nickname.
key_results: Conan was swallowed by a great serpent.
He cut his way out and lost skin and hair.
The beast's blood stained the lake red.
A later form puts Patrick in the serpent.
